resources.string: A short page about ListenLock, read aloud at once. Remove it from the library any time.

Welcome to ListenLock. This is a short sample book, read aloud by a voice that lives on your phone. No internet is needed, and nothing you read leaves your phone.

Tap any sentence to start reading from there. Long-press a sentence to bookmark it, highlight it, look up a word, copy it, or fix how a word is said.

You can make the voice faster or slower, and pick another voice. The sleep timer stops reading when you fall asleep, and you can shake the phone to give it more time.

Reading keeps going with the screen off or in other apps. Your place is kept in every book, to the sentence.

When you are ready, go back to the library and add your own book: a PDF, an EPUB, a Word file, text, or photos of pages.
